parameters.name: ImagePipelineId
parameters.description: The image template ID. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for paging queries. Valid values: 1 to 500.

Default value: 50.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of `NextToken` returned by the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the enterprise resource group. When you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1000.

>Filtering by the default resource group is not supported.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
